dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid, linear 2D narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, resulting in a sharp triangular profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None; the lateral edges are smooth and exhibit high bilateral symmetry with no visible bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-light grey; the skin tone is uniform across the visible dorsal plane, significantly darker than mature adult white.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark circular blowhole aperture visible at the anterior cranial region.
